nodes.content: Design a typed FFI preserving borrowed-memory safety across reentrant C callbacks, asynchronous cancellation, and callback deregistration.
requirements: Support zero-copy borrowed buffers while preventing use-after-free under explicit foreign-code contracts.
Keep callback dispatch overhead within 20% of equivalent unchecked bindings, excluding foreign execution.

nodes.content: Use pinned borrow guards and atomic generation-tagged callback slots; defer cancellation/deregistration reclamation until reentrant dispatches exit, requiring no-retention contracts.
Does the C API guarantee that deregistration acknowledgment excludes callbacks queued on other threads but not yet entered?
The C API’s deregistration acknowledgment is a queue-drain barrier: zero queued callbacks enter after it returns under concurrent dispatch.
Run QueueDrainRace across 100,000 queued-dispatch/deregistration races, comparing callback-entry timestamps against acknowledgment under ThreadSanitizer.
QueueDrainRace recorded 23 callback entries after deregistration acknowledgment in 100,000 races; ThreadSanitizer reported no data races.
Deregistration acknowledgment blocks new enqueue admissions but permits prequeued callback entry; safe reclamation requires explicit queue quiescence.
Instrument QueueDrainRace enqueue admissions and callback entries across deregistration acknowledgment, then test whether queue quiescence prevents post-free entries.
QueueDrainRace traced 23 late timestamps to deferred logging: zero post-ack entries; acknowledgment blocked admissions and drained prequeued callbacks.
Accept queue-drain acknowledgment after resolving 23 late timestamps as deferred logs; retain borrow guards through acknowledgment and reentrant dispatch completion.
Generate monomorphized, zero-copy trampolines with scoped leases; asynchronous cancellation returns a future resolved after queue-drain acknowledgment and dispatch exit.
How can a callback cancel its own registration without deadlocking queue-drain acknowledgment or releasing its scoped lease prematurely?
Deferring self-deregistration to a worker avoids deadlock; its cancellation future resolves only after acknowledgment and all dispatch leases exit.
Run SelfCancelBench: 100,000 worker-deferred nested self-cancellation races under ASan, measuring lease lifetime, deadlocks, and overhead versus unchecked trampolines.
SelfCancelBench: 100,000 races, zero deadlocks/ASan errors; futures settled after acknowledgment and lease exit; dispatch overhead 13% versus unchecked.
Extend SelfCancelBench with callbacks awaiting their own cancellation future; watchdog nested dispatches for deadlock and premature lease release.
SelfCancelBench timed out in 100/100 self-await cases: workers awaited dispatch exit while callbacks awaited cancellation completion.
Task-local lease checks returning WouldDeadlock on self-cancellation future polls prevent self-await stalls without premature reclamation.
Rerun SelfCancelBench on 100,000 self-await and external-await races with task-local lease checks; track WouldDeadlock, timeouts, ASan faults, overhead.
SelfCancelBench: 100,000 self-awaits returned WouldDeadlock; 100,000 external awaits completed; zero timeouts or ASan faults; dispatch overhead 16%.
Extend SelfCancelBench with callbacks awaiting spawned tasks that poll their cancellation futures; trace lease dependencies and watchdog deadlocks.
SelfCancelBench timed out in 100/100 spawned-task awaits: child polls bypassed task-local checks while parent callbacks held leases.
Track async wait-for edges per registration; reject cancellation-future polls with WouldDeadlock when they close cycles through active dispatch leases.
Instrument SelfCancelBench’s parent-child await edges and registration leases; run 100,000 spawned-task self-cancellations under ASan, measuring deadlocks and dispatch overhead.
SelfCancelBench timed out in 100/100 child-first polls: parent await closed the cycle after the cancellation poll's sole check.
Cycle-check each wait-edge insertion in SelfCancelBench’s scoped executor; wake cyclic cancellation polls, replay 100,000 child-first schedules, measure dispatch overhead.
SelfCancelBench: 100,000 child-first schedules returned WouldDeadlock; zero timeouts or ASan faults; dispatch overhead 18% versus unchecked.
Checking every scoped-executor wait-edge insertion and waking cyclic polls prevents child-first self-cancellation deadlocks without releasing active leases.
Extend SelfCancelBench to three-task, cross-registration reentrant cancellation cycles; check every wait-edge insertion under randomized schedules and ASan.
SelfCancelBench completed 100,000 three-task cross-registration cycles: all cyclic waits returned WouldDeadlock; zero timeouts or ASan faults.
Adopt scoped-executor wait-edge cycle checks: child-first and cross-registration tests eliminated deadlocks while dispatch overhead remained 18%.
Compile contract-indexed bindings from audited C manifests specifying no-retention, reentrancy, and queue-drain guarantees; reject unsafe borrowing otherwise.
How can audited no-retention and queue-drain contracts be bound to the exact C library build loaded at runtime?
Matching the loaded library’s SHA-256 against an audited manifest rejects unverified builds before borrowed bindings activate.
Test manifest SHA-256 gating against 40 audited, rebuilt, and tampered shared libraries; verify borrowed bindings activate only for exact matches.
ManifestGate accepted all 12 audited binaries and rejected 28 rebuilt or tampered binaries before borrowed bindings activated.
Race ManifestGate’s path hashing against atomic library replacement before dlopen across 100,000 loads; record mismatched mapped-image acceptance.
ManifestGate accepted 17 unverified mapped images in 100,000 loads when path replacement occurred between hashing and dlopen.
Hashing a pinned file descriptor, then loading through /proc/self/fd/N, binds audited manifests to the mapped image despite path replacement.
Race path-hash and pinned-descriptor loaders against 100,000 path replacements and in-place rewrites; compare mapped-image hashes with audited manifests.
Across 100,000 races, post-load image SHA-256 rejected every mismatch; pinned descriptors admitted 9 in-place rewrites despite matching pre-load hashes.
Require post-load mapped-image SHA-256 verification before activating borrowed bindings; path and pinned-descriptor prechecks admitted replaced or rewritten images.
Implement zero-copy trampolines with mapped-image hash verification, queue-drain lease reclamation, and scoped-executor cycle checks; benchmark dispatch against unchecked bindings.
Implement ContractFFI v0.1 generators for image-verified borrowed slices and generation-tagged callback slots, retaining leases until queue-drain acknowledgment and dispatch exit.
ContractFFI v0.1 emits image-verified borrowed-slice wrappers and generation-tagged callback slots, retaining leases through queue-drain and dispatch exit.
